# A pane whose program has ended (kept open, its error to be read) takes no
# prompt: queued there, the text stays in the composer rather than going
# with the pane's queue at its next look.
type:libertty +split -e 'echo BOOM-$((40+2)); exit 3'
key:enter
wait:2.5
expect:Exited with status 3
key:cmd+shift+e
expect-composer:open
type:late prompt
key:cmd+shift+enter
wait:0.5
expect-composer:open
expect-composer:text=late prompt
expect-queue:0
